text.p: Shares in British instrumentation and specialist components group Roxboro Group rose over 11 percent on Monday, recouping some of the heavy losses suffered on Friday after a profits warning.
Roxboro shares were up 12p at 135p with over 3.25 million shares traded. The broader market was slightly weak.

The shares plunged 39 percent on Friday after the company said it expected its profits for the year to be below market expectations, citing low demand for some of its products. It saw no immediate prospect of a meaningful recovery in demand at its Dialight Electronics Product Group.
"The shares had a huge fall on Friday and there was some favourable comment in the press at the weekend so we've got a bit of a bounce," one trader said.
Traders said news that a Roxboro director had bought 50,000 Roxboro shares had also helped the shares pick up.
